title: TRACER: Per-Tool Context Retention for LLM Agents via Consequence-Attributed Reinforcement Learning

rs.key_step: 轻量Beta policy逐tool-output-instance决定保留比例；sessioncost加observed recall floor与learned单slot keepall反事实credit。
rs.why_non_obvious: 压缩省token可能引发重调用，必须把整session后果纳入；模型counterfactual仍需intervention验证。
rs.trigger_condition: When compression savings trigger expensive re-invocations, optimize per-output retention against downstream session consequences.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When compression savings trigger expensive re-invocations, optimize per-output retention against downstream session consequences.

signatures.failure_boundary: production40heldoutqueries，reference计数window不是严格causal matching；learned costdelta有误差，非无偏因果保证。

relevance.how: 总成本必须包括后续recover调用，crop/revisit不能只计当前cost。
counterfactual outcome模型需实际单工具干预核验。
